name: darwin-skill
examples_zh: 请用 Darwin Skill 给这个 SKILL.md 做 8 维评分，并指出结构、触发条件和工具使用上的薄弱项。
对我的 agent skill 运行自动优化，使用棘轮机制保留评分更高的版本并生成对比结果。
帮我 review 一个新写的 skill，基于测试 prompts 验证改进后是否比原版更稳定。
examples_en: Use Darwin Skill to score this SKILL.md with the 8-dimension rubric and identify weaknesses in structure, triggers, and tool usage.
Run autonomous optimization on my agent skill, keep the higher-scoring version with the ratchet mechanism, and generate a comparison result.
Review a newly written skill and validate with test prompts whether the improved version is more stable than the original.
description_zh: 自主优化 Agent Skill（8维评分、棘轮机制、自动改进）
description_en: Autonomous skill optimizer with 8-dim rubric and ratchet mechanism
